method: Read the nearest AGENTS.md before inspection.
Queried the existing Graphify graph before scoped source inspection.
Mapped semantically equivalent source, validation and LLM role paths.
Did not run make verify because it regenerates committed derived pages and LLM artifacts.
Made no changes to the audited project.

project.name: X-Lab
project.graph_query: Which files implement the human wiki, LLM wiki, evidence governance, source register, evidence matrix, validation queue, design contract, Graphify publication, verification, dependency management, local service, and deployment?

local_runtime_probe.finding: The project conformance page explicitly says no canonical wiki URL or hosting target has been established.

formal_conformance.reason: No .wiki-standard.yaml exists. The project explicitly documents why OKF, graph publication, JJ and hosting were not adopted, but narrative exclusions are not DenchCo waivers.

profile_assessment.declared_legacy_profile: Contemporary wiki baseline with intentionally unadopted optional capabilities
profile_assessment.summary: The clearest minimal compatibility exemplar: strong Karpathy-style human/LLM generation, deterministic validation and source extraction, with graph publication, OKF, JJ and hosting intentionally absent.

limitations: Provenance exists, but rows have no stable machine identities or anchors.

candidate_false_positive_risks.finding: Finding graphify-out/graph.json must not pass the published 2D/3D graph requirement.
An explicit narrative decision not to adopt a capability is NOT_IMPLEMENTED or NOT_APPLICABLE, not WAIVED without a standard manifest.
Pages summarising supplier security controls must not be mistaken for repository security/source policy.

candidate_false_negative_risks.finding: docs/further-research-priorities.md performs the validation-queue role despite a different filename.
The source register is docs/sources/index.md rather than sources.md.
The agent surface is docs/llm/ rather than docs/llm-wiki/.
Absent optional Graph/JJ/deployment capabilities should not erase strong human/LLM and extraction conformance evidence.

recommendations: Add a manifest mapping existing semantic roles without renaming docs/llm, docs/sources/index.md or further-research-priorities.md.
Introduce stable source IDs and anchors while preserving the descriptive source index.
Add design lint/token checks to make the existing DESIGN.md contract executable.
Choose a stable URL/runtime only if a Human Wiki conformance claim is wanted; publish 2D/3D Graphify only if that capability becomes applicable.
Implement OKF, JJ and deployment as deliberate profile additions rather than mandatory retrofits, and add the repository security/source policy set.
audit_limitations: The audit included 29 pre-existing dirty working-tree entries.
No local URL was probed because the project explicitly declares that none is canonical.
Generator and strict-build claims were inspected but not replayed to avoid changing derived files.
Raw Graphify was queried for routing; it is not evidence authority or a publication check.
